root_cause: The deployment in inventory/cache.py introduced unbounded per-request retention: record_view() appends a dict containing a 64KB bytearray to _recent_views on every stock lookup, so memory grows with traffic instead of staying bounded. The /stock/{sku} handler calls this path for each request, making the leak immediately visible as rising service memory.
evidence: inventory/cache.py:10-12 appends bytearray(SNAPSHOT_PADDING_BYTES) to _recent_views on every call
inventory/cache.py:1-7 defines _recent_views as a plain list, not a bounded structure
inventory/app.py:19-25 calls cache.record_view(sku, level) on each /stock/{sku} request
deployment commit 0701563 is the only change tied to inventory/cache.py
